evaluation: Fresh state per window; evenly spaced starts; Read and NoRead on the same targets

numerical_contract.age_initialization: -(occurrence age)/64; age starts1 for the immediately previous write
numerical_contract.arithmetic: F32 offline continuous dense affine and softmax computation; approximate floating transport, not exact Z[phi] or target serving
numerical_contract.quaternion_sign: q and -q remain distinct; no hemisphere canonicalization
numerical_contract.read: Query/Key from RMS-normalized provisional/written states, each lifted to the hyperboloid x0=sqrt(1+|x|^2); Value=tanh(affine(normalized written state)); score=exp(read.lorentz_log_beta)*(read.lorentz_offset-arcosh(max(q0*k0-<q,k>,1+1e-6)))+learned age, competing with learned NoRead

read_geometry.admission: Bounded candidate admission is unchanged; this score ranks admitted candidates only
read_geometry.offset: read.lorentz_offset; learned scalar radius initialized arcosh(1+2*r*d/(r+d)), the distance between independent initial query/key rows
read_geometry.scale: exp(read.lorentz_log_beta); learned scalar initialized ln(sinh(offset0)/sqrt(r)), matching the Dot read scale to first order
read_geometry.scope: F32 offline training and evaluation only; no quantized interface, packed export or integer arcosh kernel

numerical_contract.retention_initialization: Each R4 lane has one constant initial update-gate bias with log-spaced tau4..64; learned coordinate gates may subsequently differ
numerical_contract.session: Same core with detached parameters/state, exact token/occurrence tape, bounded context without eviction
numerical_contract.training_credit: Full differentiable unroll; no state or memory detach; labels only enter next-token NLL
numerical_contract.transport: PerR4 lane q=normalize(e0+alpha*raw), left Hamilton multiplication; ordinary control H(v)H(e0), v=normalize(e0+alpha/sqrt2*raw)
numerical_contract.transport_zero_rule: Clamp squared denominator before sqrt; at norm<=minimum select identity e0 with finite excluded-branch arithmetic
numerical_contract.write_order: Read previous occurrences, update state, write current observed token Key/Value for next step

scope: Exploratory from-scratch fit; equal budget per geometry; not a frozen campaign or capability qualification
training_objective: Window-count-weighted mean of read-enabled and NoRead next-token NLL
window_sampler: SplitMix64 counter seeded with seed ^ 0x5EED0FD8; uniform window starts
